sources.license: City and County of San Francisco open data

sources.name: MTA.stopsigns

sources.license: City and County of San Francisco open data
sources.methodology: SFMTA traffic signal, flasher, and related-equipment inventory.
sources.name: MTA.signals

sources.license: City and County of San Francisco open data
sources.methodology: SFMTA Digital Curb policy linework by block face.
sources.name: MTA.curb_zones_all_policies

inferred_shelter_mesh.note: SFMTA source verifies stop types and amenities, but does not publish shelter dimensions on that page.

summary.storage_note: Street furniture is published as a lazy sidecar and is not embedded in sf-corridor-3d.json.
